case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised cleanliness, friendly and helpful staff, comfortable beds or rooms, family-friendly touches (child bed, free parking), bathtubs and generally good value for money; several noted an above-average breakfast for a simple hotel. Negative comments mentioned thin pillows, a nonfunctional handheld shower, a very sunken mattress and some cramped room layouts. Reviews combine strong staff/service positives with occasional room and bedding issues.
